principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class needs to be modified to support each new shape, violating the open/closed principle. Every time a new shape is introduced, the sum method needs to be adjusted.
principle_violations.suggestion: Utilize polymorphism by introducing a Shape interface with a getArea method and let each shape implement this interface.

principle_violations.reason: The List<Object> for shapes breaks the Liskov Substitution Principle as not all objects will necessarily be shape-related and the AreaCalculator assumes a specific interface for processing.
principle_violations.suggestion: Change the List<Object> to List<Shape> to ensure the collection contains only objects that adhere to the Shape interface.
